  expressions (`str(_upload(...))`). All require deliberately written code, unlike
  the accidental bare-discard incident class (all 6+ real offenders are bare Expr
  statements); `_ =` is greppable and partially covered by ruff's unused-variable

- **Bare `import explore_persona_space.orchestrate.hub`** (module-path attribute
  form) is documented v1 out-of-scope and has ZERO live instances under `scripts/`
